tex_content.html:
Corollary
[Low-Dimensional Curvature Spaces] ↗ prop:dim-algebraic-curvature-tensors ↗ lem:kulkarni-nomizu-properties ↗ prop:right-inverse-trace 1. ch7:7.25

Let $(V,g)$ be an $n$-dimensional real scalar-product space.

  1. If $n=0$ or $n=1$, then $\mathscr R(V^*)=\{ 0\} $.

  2. If $n=2$, then $\mathscr R(V^*)$ is one-dimensional and spanned by $g\owedge g$.

  3. If $n=3$, then $\mathscr R(V^*)$ is six-dimensional and $G:\Sigma ^2(V^*)\to \mathscr R(V^*)$ is an isomorphism.

Proof

\sketch Formula (7.36) gives the dimensions. For $n=2$, $\operatorname {tr}_g(g\owedge g)=2g\ne 0$, so $g\owedge g$ spans. For $n=3$, $G$ is injective and both its domain and codomain have dimension six.

□
